scoring: Primary recall treats review/error as missed confirmed detections. Triage recall also credits review. Selective accuracy excludes review/error. Repair quality uses exact gold-section text; null means no proposals, not perfect quality. Wilson intervals treat sections as independent and are descriptive for these constructed fixtures.

release_gates.policy: Zero observed incorrect safe repairs and operational errors on these fixtures. Unit regressions separately enforce basic useful repairs. This gate is not a statistical guarantee.
